openings.claim: Inherited times and 90-minute slots may hide feasible allocations; equipment or window scarcity may instead bind.
openings.discriminator: Requirement-based allocation improves fulfillment, or specific piano/evening deficits persist despite vacancy.
openings.fit: Preserve C1-C4; shorter sessions require confirmation.
openings.probe: Interview twelve contacts for total needs, windows, equipment, usable durations and outside rehearsals. Compare current and paper schedules; allocate weekly minimums first, fix performances, identify infeasibility and confirm changes.
openings.uncertainty: Requirements may be unreliable; vacancy and lateness establish neither usable capacity nor safe reclamation.

openings.claim: A numbered desk master, confirmed changes and dated online copy may reduce divergent expectations and reconciliation.
openings.discriminator: Record-related conflicts fall; duplicate arrivals despite matching confirmations suggest other causes. Overhead may exceed savings.
openings.probe: Pilot shared-master booking/key collection and confirmation; log conflict histories and all copying/call minutes weekly.
openings.uncertainty: Shared-master accessibility and causes of two duplicate arrivals remain unverified.

openings.claim: Consented multi-group exchange cycles may unlock suitable time unavailable through isolated changes.
openings.discriminator: One fully accepted cycle satisfies an unmet request beyond what free-slot assignment achieves.
openings.fit: Preserve C1-C4 and affected groups' durations, equipment and windows.
openings.probe: Record exchange willingness; seek one paper cycle. Retain originals until unanimous phone/in-person consent, then confirm master/copy updates. Pilot and count usable time, conflicts and all administration.
openings.uncertainty: Useful cycles, reliable coordination and routine operation within two weekly administration hours are unproven.

lineage.reason: Exchange dependencies and incremental benefit remain distinct.

decision: Establish requirements, compare allocations and free slots, then test any qualifying cycle alongside record confirmation. Claim success only after eight weeks show at least 90% need fulfillment, fewer than two conflicts and mean administration at most 120 minutes/week.
